overlays.note:
selling climax 29 Sep (high, downtrend); 7 Oct no supply - moderate significance in a downtrend with strength in the background; Strength 85
Context now: sideways / range (above the 50-day, lower highs and lower lows); background: selling climax 29 Sep; stopping volume 21 Jul on 2.0x volume, closed on the low - in a range: can be bullish but harder to read (neutral-ish) (moderate significance); shakeout 22 Jul on 2.3x volume, closed on the high - a flush under the range lows that recovered: supply removed (high significance); three tests 6 Aug–16 Sep on volume 26% below average - (then: uptrend) a low-volume test with strength behind it: supply is drying up (moderate significance); a no-supply bar 17 Aug on volume 45% below average - no selling pressure inside an uptrend: significant (moderate significance); selling climax 29 Sep on 2.2x volume, closed off the lows - (then: downtrend) after a decline: panic supply absorbed by professional buying, at support / new lows (high significance); a no-supply bar 2 Oct on volume 24% below average - (then: downtrend) no selling pressure after climactic strength: background has changed (low significance: marginal bar); last 5 bars: up bars on heavier volume (0.7x vs 0.6x) = demand in control; latest: no supply 7 Oct on 0.5x volume, closed off the lows - (then: downtrend) no selling pressure after climactic strength: background has changed (moderate significance); balance strength 85/100.

rs.src: RS line = MNDY close ÷ SPY Massive (formerly Polygon.io) grouped-daily adjusted bars, RS cache feeds/rs/cache/grouped close on the same date (same data source as the chart bars; dates without a SPY close are skipped, never interpolated); drawn as the light-blue line in the RS panel over every bar of the chart (own scale, fitted to the bars in view; 1W / 1M: older periods from the 10y history ÷ SPY, data/tf/SPY.json) and shown in the bar tooltip. Blue dot under a price bar = RS line above its prior 251 bars (52-week RS-line high) while the close is NOT at a 252-bar closing high (RS leads price); RS-line highs together with price are listed in the tooltip only. Dots need 252 bars of RS history: judged from 2025-10-06.

rating.label: IBD-style RS (our calc, not IBD's official rating)
rating.src: feeds/rs/latest.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py: raw = 2·ROC63 + ROC126 + ROC189 + ROC252, percentile 1-99; rank 1 = strongest)

hist.rule: STRONG (bright green): rating >= 70 and d >= +3 · FIRM (dark green): rating >= 70 and -3 < d < +3 · WEAK (dark red): rating < 50 or d <= -10 · NEUTRAL (olive): everything else (rating 50-69, or 3-10 below its MA). A band switches only after the new state holds 2 sessions in a row; no band before the MA21 exists.
hist.src: RS rating history: feeds/rs/rating_history.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py; each session ranked from the Massive grouped-daily cache using only bars up to that session; only sessions with a full 252-session lookback). History for MNDY starts 2025-10-07 and ends 2026-10-08; no rating is drawn before it (the plan's 2y of daily bars minus the 252-session lookback); the light-blue RS line covers every bar. Orange line = 21-session simple moving average of the rating (needs 21 consecutive rated sessions).
